_comment: Disposition of every patch Astro applies, for the Astro Next baseline (issue #6).
This is the one part of the patch inventory that cannot be generated: what a
patch is FOR, and what is meant to happen to it, is a judgement.
tools/baseline/inventory_patches.py joins this against the two series files
and FAILS in both directions -- a patch with no disposition, or a disposition
naming a patch that does not exist -- so this file cannot drift from reality
without CI noticing.
disposition: keep | replace | remove | investigate
keep         survives Astro Next essentially as-is
replace      the behaviour survives; this implementation does not
remove       the behaviour goes away
investigate  the disposition is genuinely not yet decided. Recorded as an
open question rather than guessed -- a wrong 'keep' is worse
than an honest 'investigate'.
effect: user-visible | security/privacy | build-only | none
replacement_issue: the Astro Next issue that owns the replacement.
'groups' entries apply to every inherited ungoogled patch under that
directory. Writing 112 individually-reasoned dispositions for patches Astro
did not author is volume without added confidence; #8 owns curating them.
A per-patch entry always wins over its group.

note: Two files in patches/astro/ were 0 bytes and were removed from the stack:
an empty file is not a patch, and git apply rejects it outright.
chrome/browser/BUILD.gn. It was 9580 bytes at 264d449 and 0 bytes from
9cc1043 onward. The previous patch runner counted its failure and carried
MEASURED CONSEQUENCE on a real, fully patched checkout at the locked
commit: zero references to browser/oxy in any BUILD.gn or .gni. Nothing in
the committed pipeline compiles the Astro overlay.
035-auth-https-callback.patch was 0 bytes throughout its recorded history.
Restoring 007 is a product change and is NOT done here: the overlay's own
BUILD.gn is under active uncommitted development, so where the target
should be declared is #7's decision, not a baseline's.

core/inox-patchset.purpose: Inherited inox-patchset hardening: disables Google-service integrations and default extensions.

core/iridium-browser.purpose: Inherited Iridium patches, chiefly Safe Browsing incident reporting.

core/ungoogled-chromium.purpose: Inherited ungoogled-chromium core: removes Google account and sync infrastructure, hard-coded API keys, reporting and field trials.

extra/ungoogled-chromium.purpose: Inherited ungoogled-chromium extras: optional behaviour changes beyond the core set.

upstream-fixes.purpose: Upstream build fixes carried by ungoogled-chromium for this Chromium version.

001-branding-strings.patch.purpose: Replaces user-facing Chromium strings with Astro in .grd resources.

002-branding-product-name.patch.purpose: Sets the product name in the BRANDING file the build system reads.

003-branding-linux-package.patch.purpose: Linux package metadata: package name, maintainer, description.

004-default-search-duckduckgo.patch.purpose: Makes DuckDuckGo the default search engine and curates the prepopulated list.

006-user-agent-astro.patch.purpose: Adds an Astro token to the User-Agent string.

008-os-crypt-visibility.patch.purpose: Widens OSCrypt visibility so the token store can encrypt at rest.

009-branding-settings-strings.patch.purpose: Astro branding in the settings surface strings.

010-oxy-theme-color.patch.purpose: Plumbs the Oxy brand colour into the theme provider.

011-astro-url-scheme-alias.patch.purpose: Aliases astro:// onto chrome:// — a cosmetic alias, not a real scheme.

013-settings-google-to-oxy.patch.purpose: Replaces Google references in the settings UI with Oxy.

015-oxy-profile-menu-impl.patch.purpose: Implements the Oxy profile-menu header rendering.

016-ntp-astro-logo.patch.purpose: Swaps the NTP logo for the Astro mark.

019-ntp-default-sites.patch.purpose: Replaces the prepopulated NTP tiles, removing the Google-owned defaults.

020-register-oxy-prefs.patch.purpose: Registers the Oxy profile and local-state preferences.

021-omnibox-display-astro.patch.purpose: Displays astro:// instead of chrome:// in the omnibox.

022-autocomplete-astro-scheme.patch.purpose: Teaches autocomplete about the astro:// scheme.

025-astro-scheme-register.patch.purpose: Registers astro:// as a known scheme.

026-navigator-astro-rewrite.patch.purpose: Rewrites astro:// navigations to chrome:// in the navigator.

028-security-display-astro.patch.purpose: Security UI treats astro:// as an internal page.

029-copy-url-astro.patch.purpose: Copying an internal URL yields the astro:// form.

031-linux-icon-name.patch.purpose: Uses the astro-browser icon name in the Linux integration.

033-shared-settings-google-to-oxy.patch.purpose: Same substitution in shared settings strings.

034-profiles-google-to-oxy.patch.purpose: Same substitution in the profiles UI.

036-navigator-auth-intercept.patch.purpose: Intercepts auth.oxy.so redirects in the navigator.

037-builtin-provider-astro-scheme.patch.purpose: Builtin omnibox provider offers astro:// URLs.

038-dino-game-astro-scheme.patch.purpose: Offline dino game reachable over astro://.

039-auth-navigation-throttle-register.pa.purpose: Registers the Oxy auth navigation throttle.

040-tab-hover-astro-scheme.patch.purpose: Tab hover card shows the astro:// form.

042-session-restore-astro.patch.purpose: Session restore persists and restores astro:// URLs.

043-web-app-astro-scheme.patch.purpose: Web-app handling for the astro:// scheme.

044-disable-ev-certificate-metadata.patc.purpose: Disables the EV certificate metadata fetch, which is Google-hosted.

045-adblock-throttle-register.patch.purpose: Registers the adblock URL loader throttle in the network stack.

047-alia-side-panel-entry-id.patch.purpose: Declares the Alia side-panel entry id.

050-alia-side-panel-register.patch.purpose: Registers Alia in the side-panel registry.

053-adblock-toolbar-button.patch.purpose: Adds the adblock shield toolbar button.

054-adblock-webui-register.patch.purpose: Registers AstroAdBlockUIConfig. KNOWN DEFECT: reverted by the overlay's whole-file copy of chrome_web_ui_configs.cc, so the adblock WebUI is never registered (issue #4).

055-ntp-webui-register.patch.purpose: Registers AstroNtpUIConfig in the WebUI config map.

056-ntp-redirect-to-astro.patch.purpose: Redirects chrome://newtab to the Astro NTP.

057-oxy-webui-build-edge.patch.purpose: Makes //chrome/browser/ui/webui:configs depend on the overlay's two WebUI targets. Without this edge nothing in the build graph reaches chrome/browser/oxy, so the whole overlay compiles to zero objects and the configs the registration patches name do not link.

058-alia-webui-register.patch.purpose: Registers AstroAliaUIConfig. The Alia side panel loads chrome://alia into a WebView, so without the registration the panel renders an error page.
